task.description: Implement OBS-02 (Prometheus metrics) per src/design/obs-02-prometheus-metrics.md. Add GET /metrics returning Prometheus text format with content-type text/plain; version=0.0.4 and no auth requirement. Implement required metric families and labels: bpm_active_instances_total (gauge), bpm_task_completions_total{definition_id} (counter), bpm_event_append_duration_seconds (histogram), bpm_db_query_duration_seconds{query_type} (histogram), bpm_http_requests_total{method,path,status} (counter), bpm_http_errors_total{path} for 5xx (counter). Wire instrumentation across HTTP middleware/routing, DB query execution, event append path, and task completion flow. Ensure metrics scrape path is non-blocking and does not delay API request processing; during DB outage /metrics must still return 200 with available in-memory metrics and may expose stale active-instance gauge. Apply any required migration or runtime wiring changes. Validate with zig build, zig build test, and zig build test-integration before completing.
acceptance_criteria: GET /metrics returns 200 with Prometheus text content type and no auth
All required OBS-02 metric families and labels are emitted
Histogram bucket strategy supports p50/p95/p99 analysis
Metrics collection and scrape handling are non-blocking for request processing
DB outage edge case returns 200 with in-memory metrics and stale gauge tolerance
